fichas.title: Rooflighting
fichas.summary: Design guidance for daylight entering interiors through rooflights. It covers daylight distribution and uniformity, minimum daylight-factor criteria, rooflight spacing relative to room height, roof-opening pitch, and the effects of light-shaft depth. Rooflights receive brighter sky light than side windows; delicate, highly reflective shaft construction is recommended, and the cave effect should be avoided.
uses: Achieve adequate and uniform interior illumination
